only accepted knowledge is compiled: a proposed or superseded member blocks the scope rather than being dropped from it

Not for modelling the domain, which is model-domain; not for changing one recorded fact; and not for generating code.

required_context.note: Ingestion authors into any of the six and orders the authoring by node type, so the whole vocabulary is in scope as a sequence rather than as a selection.

the classification is validated against knowledge-intake-plan/1 before any object is authored

grant.note: The skill states no allowed-tools, so it runs under the session's grant, recorded rather than implied. It is not model-invocable: it writes a knowledge base.
